text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wah, it's Big Brother~!
I'm so happy I got to meet up with Big Brother right away♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wah, it's Big Sister~!
I'm so happy I got to meet up with Big Sister right away♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Look, look? Don't you think Curren's eyes
are wide and bright, and her skin super soft this morning?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Actually, Curren tried that deep-sleep stretch
that everyone's talking about! *Ahem*!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Delivering an extra-cute Curren
to start your morning off right~♪

Curren Chan seems to have made great use of her day off,
getting herself back into top shape!
